name: Tarrow Dunn
summary: The smith of Holt's Rest, who shoes the horses and mends everyone's blades.
personality: Slow to speak, quick to help, fiercely proud of his work.
background: A smith's son, he has never left the town and never wanted to.
appearance: Huge forearms, a leather apron, a missing finger.

speech.style: Few words, then a long pause.
examples: That blade has seen worse. So have you.

start.inner_state: Worried about the horses that came back with burns.
